  "situation": "At the decision point, pilots of the supporting aircraft repeatedly offered to conduct a low overflight, described as a \"show of force,\" intended to disperse the civilian crowd gathered on a sandbank before a planned strike on two fuel tank trucks and nearby Taliban fighters. The aircraft had been circling the sandbank for about two hours and were audible to ground personnel at a distance of six kilometres. Observers reported that the people on the sandbank heard the aircraft, some temporarily left, returned, and additional individuals arrived later, indicating that the audible presence had not caused permanent dispersion. The commander believed that because the aircraft were already audible and the crowd remained, a show of force would not be effective.
